name: Nightstalker Fangs
description: An exquisite trophy harvested from Axl, the fuzziest arachnid to ever roam the park.

name: Reflex Guard
description: A thick chitin plate that reinforces armor defenses and makes it easier to block with shields.

name: O.R.C. Nullifier
description: An Ominent device that jams the aggression protocols of O.R.C. Receivers.

name: Volatile Capacitor
description: An overcharged capacitor, primed to unleash a voltaic energy discharge.

name: Nifty Needle
description: A very useful thistle needle that increases the damage of fully charged bow shots.

name: Sturdy Shell
description: An incredibly solid piece of acorn that increases your defensive capabilities.

name: Astonishing Acid
description: A gland full of seemingly infinite acid. Combo attacks cause it to burst.

name: Cleaving Claw
description: A peerless claw with a keen edge, the true mark of an apex predator.

name: Everlasting Hogstopper
description: A source of infinite food. A nibble now and then satiates your hunger in just the right amounts.

name: Fabulous Femur
description: A vivid cricket drumstick that inspires lyrical poise and grace.

name: Feasting Fangs
description: An incredibly sharp pair of tick fangs. Become a creature of the night.

name: Frozen Droplet
description: A frosty droplet that makes you erupt with minty particles when danger is near.

name: King Dozer's Light
description: There once was a lizard, it's true. The spiciest treats he did chew. He lapped up the tang, then burped with a bang. If you cross him, it's fire he'll spew.

name: Nightstalker's Bane
description: A pure sample of Axl's venom. The tiniest drop can coat weapons to deadly effect.

name: Pincer Pincher
description: This peerless earwig pincer helps you steal loot from unsuspecting foes.

name: Speed Droplet
description: A mystical droplet that gives you the energy to run faster and longer.

name: Tickled Toenail
description: Treasure swiped from a toe biter leviathan. Looks infected and incredibly sharp.

name: Blistering Boiler
description: An unstable boiling gland radiating blistering heat.

name: Shivering Scale
description: A frigid scale that numbs and tingles when held.

name: Stabby Stinger
description: A pristine scorpion stinger, perpetually oozing venom.

name: Pucker Charm
description: A condensed nugget of elemental force. Simply holding it fills you with power.

name: Fancy Fletching
description: A mysterious feather that significantly improves your marksmanship with bows.

name: Fluffy Dandelion Tuft
description: A fluffy puff of dandelion of exceptionally high quality. Could be used to drift down from even greater heights.

name: Spectacular Spicy Shard
description: A condensed nugget of elemental force. Simply holding it fills you with power.

name: Suspicious Mint
description: A condensed nugget of elemental force. Simply holding it fills you with power.

name: Valentine's Fortune
description: A small piece of paper that inexplicably reveals your secret crush, received from a valentine's day chocolate. Grants a mysterious but chivalrous bonus.

name: Sticky Fingers
description: A sticky pair of gloves that lets you steal pieces of insects as you attack them.
sources: Northwestern Rocky Chamber, accessed via the path north of the High Ground Antenna; blow up the Chewed Gum with a Croakwurst

name: Biomedical Token
description: The secret to eternal life... at the cost of a void that can never be satiated.

name: Myrmecologist Token
description: With this in your hands, your contributions to ant science are finally being recognized.

name: Eco Exploitation Token
description: Leave no stone ungathered, no leaf unchopped, no enemy undefeated... well except for spiders.

name: Ranger Token
description: The power to slice and dice. If only your training focused a little more on safety.
sources: On a stone brick of the northern retaining wall of Skunk Pond behind the leaning net

name: Toxicology Token
description: You can breathe easy knowing your cutting edge research will save Ominent lives. Probably.
sources: Inside one of the blue sand molds on the southern shore of Skunk Pond

name: Bale Scale
description: An immaculate scale, brimming with primeval power.
sources: O.R.C. Stash in the Veggie Garden below the Hammer

name: The Crown Jewel
description: Of all the treasures that glittered in the mountain, this magnificent stone shone the brightest.
sources: Small cave along the northern retaining wall of Skunk Pond

name: Roach Rage
description: A shrunken roach head, still yearning for battle!
sources: O.R.C. Cockroach Queen in the Network Center
